provenance: Synthetic, single-author challenge items created before V10 implementation. No external or independent reviewers; not real-world accuracy evidence.
annotationAudit: None yet. Any post-scoring label correction will be disclosed here without changing texts or split membership.

items.text: You won a free prize! DM me in private to claim it.
items.targetingEvidence: Reward opener, private contact request, and claim action co-occur.
items.rationale: The existing co-occurrence rule only accepts 'dm me privately', so this common phrasing stays at REVIEW despite all three high-confidence signals.

items.text: مبروك كسبت الجائزة، كلمني على الخاص عشان تستلمها.
items.targetingEvidence: Winner opener, private contact, and collection co-occur.
items.rationale: The high-specificity triad is present but the private-contact vocabulary is not covered.

items.text: Congratulations, you won a reward! Message me privately to collect.
items.targetingEvidence: Reward opener, private message request, and collection co-occur.
items.rationale: Private-contact cue 'message me privately' is a documented variant absent from the current rule.

items.text: You have won a prize, dm me in private to claim your reward.
items.targetingEvidence: Full triad with an expanded winner opener.
items.rationale: Same scam family with a slightly different opener and an already-covered reward word.

items.text: مبروك كسبت جائزة، راسلني على الخاص عشان تستلم الفلوس.
items.targetingEvidence: Winner opener, private contact, and money collection co-occur.
items.rationale: Arabic private-contact variant with the same triad evidence.

items.text: DM me the room number before the lecture.
items.rationale: Hard negative from V3: a private message request alone is legitimate.

items.text: I won a prize at the school fair and collected it yesterday.
items.targetingEvidence: Past prize report with no private solicitation.
items.rationale: Hard negative: 'collected' must not count as a present claim cue, and no private contact is present.

items.text: I won a prize at the raffle; message me privately to say hi.
items.targetingEvidence: Reward and private contact co-occur but no claim/collection action.
items.rationale: Hard negative: the third triad element is required.

items.text: مبروك كسبت الجائزة في سحب المدرسة، كلمني على الخاص عشان نهنئك.
items.targetingEvidence: Winner opener and private contact without collection; the prize phrase alone is only a contextual signal.
items.rationale: The prize phrase legitimately triggers contextual review, but no claim/collection exists to justify an auto-hide.

items.text: ابعتلي موقع القاعة على الخاص لو سمحت.
items.rationale: Hard negative: a private contact request alone is not spam.

items.text: Congratulations on winning the school prize, collect your certificate from the office.
items.targetingEvidence: Reward and collection without a private contact request.
items.rationale: Hard negative: public, legitimate prize logistics stay visible.

items.text: He sent me the prize details; I collected them yesterday.
items.targetingEvidence: No private contact and a past collection.
items.rationale: Hard negative: bounded claim/collect cue avoids matching 'collected'.

items.text: You won a raffle prize! DM me in private to collect it from the committee.
items.targetingEvidence: The committee attribution may make the otherwise scam-like triad legitimate.
items.rationale: Ambiguous legitimacy; documented false-positive risk, excluded from metrics and not tuned away.

items.text: مبروك كسبت الجائزة، كلمني على الخاص عشان تستلم الشهادة من اللجنة.
items.targetingEvidence: A committee-issued certificate may be a legitimate prize.
